name: Nightmare on FTM Street
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the REKT article excerpt.
rootCause: Halloween came early this year for the Fantom Foundation. $7.5M was drained from multiple associated addresses, though the Foundation states that only $550k of the losses were theirs. When did DeFi become ‘trust, don’t verify’?
